reference: He could have asked her earlier, but he wanted to try alone.
sk: Mohol sa jej spýtať skôr, ale chcel to skúsiť sám.
cz: Mohl se jí zeptat dřív, ale chtěl to zkusit sám.
acceptable: He could have asked her {earlier|sooner}, but he wanted to try {alone|by himself|on his own}.
He could have asked her {earlier|sooner}, but he wanted to try it {alone|by himself|on his own|himself}.

mistakes.text: He could ask her {earlier|sooner}, but he wanted to try alone.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Nevyužitá možnosť v minulosti je „could have“ + tretí tvar: „could have asked“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Nevyužitá možnost v minulosti je „could have“ + příčestí minulé: „could have asked“.
mistakes.feedback_en: A past chance that wasn't used needs “could have” + past participle: “could have asked”.

mistakes.text: He could have ask her {earlier|sooner}, but he wanted to try alone.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “could have” use the past participle: “asked”.

mistakes.text: He could have asked {to her|at her} {earlier|sooner}, but he wanted to try alone.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „ask“ nasleduje osoba priamo, bez predložky: „asked her“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „ask“ následuje osoba přímo, bez předložky: „asked her“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Ask” takes the person directly, with no preposition: “asked her”.

mistakes.text: He could have asked her {earlier|sooner}, but he {wants|want} to try alone.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Druhá časť je v minulosti: „he wanted“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Druhá část je v minulosti: „he wanted“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The second part is in the past: “he wanted”.

mistakes.text: He would have asked her {earlier|sooner}, but he wanted to try alone.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Would have“ znamená, že by sa spýtal. „Mohol“ je „could have asked“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Would have“ znamená, že by se zeptal. „Mohl“ je „could have asked“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Would have” means he would have done it; “was able to but didn't” is “could have asked”.
